name: Alberta Energy Regulator (AER)
notes: The regulator of oil, oil sands, natural gas and mineral resource development in Alberta across the full life cycle. Freely downloadable, citable publications: the ST98 Alberta Energy Outlook (reserves, prices, supply costs, pipelines, CCUS, hydrogen/geothermal/helium/lithium emerging resources), the Information Hub performance datasets (wells drilled, methane reduction, pipeline incidents, water use, closure activity), directives and manuals. Reports carry Crown/Alberta Energy Regulator copyright — cite AER with date; the copyright page could not be located this session (site 404), so confirm terms before bulk republication. Evidence: https://www.aer.ca/about-aer (read 2026-11-03).
